newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ANZ Bank cuts fixed-rate home loan.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ANZ Bank cuts fixed-rate home loan.

text.p: The Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd announced on Friday a 55-basis-point cut in its one-year fixed-rate home loan to 7.95 percent.
The bank said it had also cut its rate on fixed residential investment property lending to 7.95 percent.
Both new rates are effective on Monday, it added.

"Competition in the mortgage market continues to be intense and we are confident that the rates we are now offering will position ANZ's home loan range at the forefront of the market," ANZ retail banking chief Peter Hawkins said in a statement.
The bank also announced it would discount its loan approval fee on the one-year fixed rate loan to A$250 from A$600 for loans approved before November 18 this year.
